# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old  <sub>[v4 c36 P4](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c28 P0](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is a fair-haired girl with long, sleek curls that are kept perfectly neat. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a mouth set in a precise expression. In her childhood, she constantly appeared clean, starched, and ironed.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Lucy is remarkably well-behaved, quiet, and submissive, rarely causing trouble or disturbance. She possesses a calm and unvarying disposition, allowing her to remain unbothered by events that upset others. Despite being easily frightened by things such as the dark or cows, she is highly tidy, dependable, and conscientious in performing small chores.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v3 c13 P28](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0028)_

## History

Lucy Farrow was born six minutes apart from her twin brother, Robin. Following the death of their mother, Mary Farrow, the twins were taken in by Thirza Abernethy to be raised at Grey Shutters with the help of Nell Harcourt. During her childhood, she endured numerous mischievous pranks by her brother, including being pushed into mud, sprayed with water under a pump, and locked inside a toolhouse. She began attending school alongside Robin under Nell's instruction, proving to be a quiet and submissive pupil. On one occasion, Robin forced her to skip Sunday School and go fishing with the Cotton children, though she spent the time holding her religious books and regretting the misadventure. As she grew older, she took on household duties at Grey Shutters with mature grace and caution. By the age of seventeen, she inherited Nell's former porch room and began attracting the romantic interest of Ralph Pullen.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c13 P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 c13 P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), [v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c36 P3](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0003), [v4 c36 P5](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0005)_
